evidence.estrutura: Ferraro worked through federal legislative institutions and did not advocate a major structural redesign; moderate federalism.
evidence.representacao: Congressional service and vice-presidential candidacy strongly support representative democracy and women’s political inclusion.
evidence.poder: Her human-rights work and mainstream liberal politics support constitutional rights while accepting ordinary law-enforcement institutions; moderate-libertarian.
evidence.imigracao: Her record is mainstream Democratic and pluralist, but immigration was not a defining issue in the selected sources; keep moderate-open.
evidence.diplomacia: As a Cold War-era mainstream Democrat, she supported alliances and active international engagement rather than pacifism or isolation.
evidence.intervencao: Her politics accepted U.S. alliance commitments and national security while not centering aggressive intervention; moderate.
evidence.economia: Economic-equality legislation and liberal social policy fit a regulated market/mixed economy.
evidence.controle: Supports anti-discrimination regulation and public policy without command planning; moderate control.
evidence.comercio: No distinctive trade doctrine is established; moderate openness.
evidence.religiao: Personally Catholic, but her public positions on reproductive rights and law were secular rather than clerical.
evidence.moral: Feminist causes, reproductive rights and women’s equality support progressive social positions.
evidence.tecnologia: Technology was not central to her political profile; moderate.
